summary_base: Java Backend Developer with 3 years of experience designing high-throughput, secure microservices and REST APIs within Service-Oriented Architectures. Skilled in Spring Boot, Kafka-based event-driven systems, and Redis caching for performance optimization, with a consistent record of applying TDD and OWASP security practices to enterprise-grade platforms.

experience.role: Software Developer I, Enterprise ERP Integration Platform

bullets.text: Cut manual ERP data entry by 60% by architecting a bidirectional sync microservice that keeps data consistent in real time across enterprise ERP systems.
Accelerated release cycles by about 40% by automating 20+ RESTful APIs and event-driven Kafka and Apache Camel workflows across 4 ERP platforms within a Service-Oriented Architecture.

Eliminated manual procurement, inventory and maintenance workflows across Oracle NetSuite, Dynamics 365, SAP and Brightly EAM by integrating the platforms and designing the relational schema for a new ERP-to-EAM integration.
Mitigated common security vulnerabilities per OWASP Top 10 guidelines by designing and implementing OAuth2-based JWT authentication through a custom Camel interceptor.
Reduced regression defects and cut connector development effort by 35-45% by following Test-Driven Development with JUnit and Mockito and building reusable adapter frameworks.
Improved integration sync throughput and reduced redundant ERP calls by implementing Redis-based caching for frequently accessed integration data.

Cut repeat production issues by 30-40% and accelerated pull request turnaround by about 30% by collaborating across 6 engineering teams on 150+ pull request reviews and authoring 20+ architecture and troubleshooting documents.
Automated procurement, inventory and maintenance data flows by using GraphQL queries against NetSuite APIs within the ERP integration platform.
Built a React dashboard for the Brightly ERP-to-EAM integration and data mapping flow.
Prototyped RAG-based documentation search and LLM-driven data extraction with Spring AI and the Claude API to evaluate their fit within the ERP integration platform.
Improved inventory forecasting accuracy by about 15% across 100+ retail outlets using Python-based forecasting and clustering models (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn).

Achieved an F1-score of 0.86 by integrating a BERT-based NLP model into a Flask backend, and co-authored the accompanying published research paper.
